scope: Cancelled bounded cold-build diagnostic on a smaller GitHub runner; not a completed build or an official Palomar hardware failure.

observations.persistent_gram_compilers: G115 through G130; same sixteen process IDs remained to cancellation, with no Gram leaf completed.
observations.interpretation: Sustained swap pressure stalled sixteen simultaneous Gram compilations; the run was deliberately cancelled, not observed to fail in Lean or be OOM-killed.

metric_limits: Cgroup memory includes preparation, other runner processes, and reclaimable file cache.
The stock 2-CPU runner with swap is not equivalent to the official 16-CPU/32-GB Palomar profile.
Cancellation prevented a final build exit status and GNU time report.

compiler_benchmarks.scope: Independent pre-chain source compilation into temporary outputs on the local macOS development machine; these are compiler RSS measurements, not NanoDa/con-ron measurements or aggregate Linux bounds.
compiler_benchmarks.method: Python resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) or per-child os.wait4; macOS reports ru_maxrss in bytes.

cases.note: All four output artifacts were byte-identical to the default-thread build; memory reduction was below 1 percent.
